principle: pre-registered conservative candidates; processing more is not success; identity gate before selection; HUMAN_REQUIRED on uncertainty

primitives.scope: full-mix; short clipped flat segments (<= 16 samples)
primitives.max_strength: linear transition over repaired segment; never exceeds neighbours
primitives.failure_state: long/edge segments reported, not repaired; NaN input -> ValueError
primitives.notes: long clipping is a mastering defect signal, not auto-fixed

primitives.scope: full-mix, any format; removes constant per-channel offset
primitives.max_strength: full DC removal (|dc| > 1e-4 fires); no gain change
primitives.notes: DC is not musical content; spectrum impact at 0 Hz only

primitives.scope: full-mix; low band (20-120 Hz) or high band (10-20 kHz) deficit
primitives.failure_state: FFT failure -> ValueError; imbalance below threshold -> bypassed
primitives.notes: not a modern-master template; never generic brightness
